svg.title: Anatomy of a cloud flow expression
svg.desc: One expression taken apart: if(empty(item()?['cedar_scheduledfor']), '', convertFromUtc(item()?['cedar_scheduledfor'], 'Jordan Standard Time', 'ddd dd MMM HH:mm')). The function if has three arguments: a condition and two results. The function empty is true for null, an empty text, an empty array and an empty object. item() is a reference to the current element inside a Select, a Filter array or a loop. The question mark before the bracket is safe navigation: a missing property gives null instead of an error. Two single quotes are an empty text literal. convertFromUtc takes a UTC time, a Windows time zone name and a format string. Below that, how expressions are written in a saved definition: an at sign followed by the expression makes the whole value the result, with its type, for example the number 3; an at sign with curly braces inside text is an inline expression whose result is converted to text, for example the text "3 open". A third panel lists the reference functions: triggerOutputs and triggerBody, outputs and body with the action name written with underscores, item and items, variables, parameters for environment variables, and workflow.
svg.text: convertFromUtc( item()?['cedar_scheduledfor'], 'Jordan Standard Time', 'ddd dd MMM HH:mm' ) )
error if the property is absent.
'' is empty text; a quote inside
How it is written in an input
Whole value: the input IS the result, with its type.
Inline in text: the result is converted to text.
Where data comes from: reference functions
Action names use underscores for spaces: the action "Needs attention" is body('Needs_attention'). Rename before you reference.
